g.text: The client stores the last sequence number it received. On reconnect it sends that number and the

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: gateway replies with a full state snapshot, not a replay of missed events. A wall display that was

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: dark for two hours therefore comes back correct in one round trip, with no operator action.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111827

g.text: Why this path never writes to the database

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Realtime state is an observation of another system, not a record of our own. Persisting it would

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: create a second, faster, less reliable version of the same facts — and every argument about which

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: number is right would start there. It lives in memory and dies with the process.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: A. Query path — synchronous, request / response

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b45309

g.text: Every response carries four metadata fields: metric version . data timestamp . day-close state ( provisional / closed / corrected ) . depends_on_unverified

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4b5563

g.text: This is what makes our figure the one that can be defended in a meeting: the number arrives with the rule that produced it and how settled it is.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Record search takes the same route, under tighter rules: a configurable criteria set with index coverage, a mandatory time range, a hard result cap, and per-role field visibility applied before any row leaves the service layer.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: B. Realtime push path — asynchronous, server initiated

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111827

g.text: The two paths are deliberately allowed to disagree. The wall shows what is happening now, sampled every few seconds from another system.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111827

g.text: The daily report shows what was settled at day-close. The reconciliation rule between them is defined in Chapter 6, not left to the reader.
